```{r import_price_table}
# See sheet names
excel_sheets("lei9795-anexoI, II, III, IV e V - parsed.xlsx") # Document was parsed using AI

# Annex I: Land value map (MVG)
annex1 <- read_excel("Land value/lei9795-anexoI, II, III, IV e V - parsed.xlsx", 
                     sheet = "Annex I")

# Annex II: Building value table for non-condominium properties
annex2 <- read_excel("Land value/lei9795-anexoI, II, III, IV e V - parsed.xlsx", 
                     sheet = "Annex II")

# Annex III: Building value table for condominium properties
annex3 <- read_excel("Land value/lei9795-anexoI, II, III, IV e V - parsed.xlsx", 
                     sheet = "Annex III")

# Annex IV: Correction factors
annex4 <- read_excel("Land value/lei9795-anexoI, II, III, IV e V - parsed.xlsx", 
                     sheet = "Annex IV")
```
